sentences.text:
Author: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
Bench: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Criminal Petition Nos.5353, 5374 And 5006 Of 2020
Common Order:

-
These petitions are filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, seeking quash of the charge sheet in C.C.No.614 of 2018 on the file of the learned Additional Junior Civil Judge,
Macharla, Guntur District and quash of the F.I.Rs. registered in Crime No.607 of 2020 of Dachepalli Police Station, Guntur District and Crime No.538 of 2020 of Jaggaiahpeta Police Station, Krishna District.

entities.text:
Additional Junior Civil Judge,
Macharla, Guntur District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor.
3.

A case under Sections 188, 273, 420 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for short "I.P.C.")
and under Section 59 (1) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short "F.S.S. Act") was registered against the petitioners in Crl.P.No.5353 of 2020; a case under Sections 188, 270, 273, 420 r/w 34 of I.P.C. and under Section 56, 63 and 57(1) of F.S.S. Act was registered against the petitioners in Crl.P.No.5374 of 2020; and a case under Sections 328, 269, 273 r/w 34 of I.P.C.,
Section 22 of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 and under Section 34(A) of the Andhra Pradesh Excise Act, 1968 was registered against the petitioners in Crl.P.No.5006 of 2020.

entities.text: Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that these are covered matters and this Court has earlier quashed the F.I.Rs and charge sheets registered for the similar offences based on identical facts.

Therefore, they would pray for quash of the present charge sheet and the F.I.Rs.
5.

Learned Additional Public Prosecutor also would fairly concede that these are covered matters in view of the earlier orders passed by this Court quashing the F.I.Rs registered for the similar offences based on identical facts.
Therefore, he would pray to pass appropriate orders according to law.

6. As can be seen from the copies of common order passed by this Court in Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch and also another common order passed in Criminal Petition Nos.5421 of Mohammad Ayub Khan, vs The State Of State Of Andhra Pradesh., on 24 November, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72281622/
1 2019 and batch, it is clear that this Court has earlier quashed several F.I.Rs registered for the similar offences based on identical facts.

entities.text: Criminal Petition Nos.5421 of Mohammad Ayub Khan, vs The State Of State Of Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, in view of the aforesaid orders, the petitioners who are similarly placed, are also entitled for quash of the charge sheet and F.I.Rs respectively in these criminal petitions.

7. In the result, these Criminal Petitions are allowed and in view of the aforesaid earlier orders of this Court and for the reasons stated therein, the charge sheet in C.C.No.614 of 2018 on the file of the learned Additional Junior Civil Judge, Macharla, Guntur District and F.I.Rs. in Crime No.607 of 2020 of Dachepalli Police Station, Guntur District and Crime No.538 of 2020 of Jaggaiahpeta Police Station, Krishna District, are hereby quashed.

entities.text: Additional Junior Civil Judge, Macharla, Guntur District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Pending applications, if any, shall stand closed.
